Position: Machine Operator, Steel/Metal Industry
Location: Marrickville
Days: Mon-Fri
Hours: 38
Pay: $33+ casual rate with potential to go FT perm
Start: ASAP
 
Summary
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Machine Operator to join our clients team in the steel industry. As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for operating and maintaining a variety of metalworking machinery to produce high-quality metal products. Your attention to detail, technical expertise, and commitment to safety will play a crucial role in our manufacturing process.
 
Company
Based in Marrickville, our company specializes in the production of a diverse range of metal products, including tables, chairs, trolleys, and other innovative solutions. They pride in their commitment to quality craftsmanship and cutting-edge design.
 
Responsibilities
* Set up and prepare metalworking machines, including lathes, milling machines, grinders, presses, and CNC machines, for production according to specifications.
* Operate machinery to shape, cut, form, or assemble metal components used in the production of a wide range of metal products, including but not limited to Connoisseur Racks, Display Racks, Primat Racks, Strip Racks, Brackets, and Clips, ensuring adherence to quality standards and production schedules.
* Monitor machine operations and conduct regular inspections to verify product accuracy and quality, making adjustments as needed.
* Perform routine maintenance tasks on machines, including cleaning, lubricating, and replacing worn parts to ensure optimal performance.
* Follow safety guidelines and protocols rigorously to maintain a safe working environment and prevent accidents.
* Collaborate with team members, supervisors, and engineers to communicate production updates, issues, and improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues, such as machine malfunctions, material inconsistencies, or quality deviations, to minimize downtime.
* Maintain accurate records of production data, machine settings, maintenance activities, and any encountered issues.
* Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and efficiency enhancement in machine operation and product quality.
* Adhere to company policies, procedures, and guidelines to maintain a productive and positive work environment.
 
Requirements
* Experience as a Machine Operator in the metal industry, with an understanding of metalworking machinery and techniques (Desirable - Training to be provided by employer)
* Proficiency in operating and troubleshooting various metalworking machines
* Solid mechanical aptitude and technical skills to perform routine maintenance and address minor mechanical issues.
* Attention to detail and precision in following instructions, measurements, and specifications.
* Excellent problem-solving skills to identify issues and implement effective solutions.
* Strong commitment to safety protocols and guidelines.
* Effective communication skills to interact with team members, supervisors, and engineers.
* Physical stamina to stand for extended periods, lift heavy materials, and perform repetitive tasks.
* Flexibility to adapt to changing production demands and learn new techniques or machinery.
* Willingness to engage in ongoing training and professional development.

Warehouse Academy is facilitating recruitment on behalf of our client. The successful applicant will be employed and paid directly by the client. Warehouse Academy is a recruitment coordination service only and is not the employer for this role.

Roma Republic is hiring a Full time Restaurant Manager role in Craigie, WA. Apply now to be part of our team.


Requirements for this role:
Flexible hours available
2-3 years of relevant work experience required for this role

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, high-energy, and hands-on Restaurant Manager to oversee the daily operations, financial performance, and guest experiences across our venue. As a key leader in our business, you will manage front-of-house staff, coordinate with the kitchen team, optimize profitability, and ensure strict compliance with health, safety, and licensing regulations.

Key Responsibilities and Duties

Operations Management: Direct and oversee the day-to-day operations of the venue to ensure exceptional customer service, smooth service flow, and high standards of hospitality.

Financial & Performance Control: Monitor and manage venue budgets, labour costs, and cost of goods sold (COGS). Analyze sales data, manage stock control, and implement strategies to maximize profitability.

Staff Leadership & Training: Recruit, train, schedule, and supervise front-of-house staff and supervisors. Foster a positive team environment, conduct performance reviews, and ensure staff adhere to service standards.

Compliance & Safety: Maintain strict compliance with workplace health and safety (WHS) regulations, food safety programs, and responsible service of alcohol (RSA) legislation.

Customer & Community Relations: Proactively manage customer feedback, resolve complaints efficiently, and build strong relationships with regular patrons to enhance the brand's local reputation.

Supplier Coordination: Liaise with suppliers, manage inventory ordering, and coordinate with the kitchen team to maintain stock levels and ensure seamless service.

Skills, Qualifications, and Experience Required

Education: An Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma, or Diploma in Hospitality Management (ANZSCO Skill Level 2); OR at least 3 years of relevant professional experience.

Experience: A minimum of 2–3 years of proven experience in a similar fast-paced restaurant management or supervisory role.

Technical & System Skills: Proficiency in modern point-of-sale (POS) management systems (e.g., Square for Restaurants or Lightspeed), staff scheduling platforms, and basic digital communication tools.

Compliance Certification: Valid Western Australia Approved Manager Licence (or ability to obtain one), Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) certificate, and Food Safety Supervisor certification.

Interpersonal Skills: Outstanding leadership, communication, and conflict-resolution skills, with a strong ability to work under pressure during peak service times.

Job Details

Location: Perth Metropolitan Area, Western Australia

Salary Range: $78,000 – $83,000 per annum (plus superannuation)

Terms of Employment: Full-time, Permanent (38 hours per week, including weekend and evening rosters)

About Roma's Café Group

Roma Café Group is an established, multi-venue café operation with locations across Perth's northern suburbs. We operate management-run, full-service café venues known for quality food, espresso coffee, and a strong community presence.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Restaurant Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations at our Craigie venue.

ABOUT US
Knight Piésold is a specialised international consulting firm offering engineering and environmental services in Mining, Environment, Hydropower, Water Resources, and Roads & Construction Services. We are proud of the longstanding relationships we have with our clients and delivery of exceptional services on a global scale.

Knight Piésold’s Australia office has a significant track-record regarding projects located in Australia, Asia and Africa. With over 100 years of experience, we work on projects which are diverse both geographically and technically.

THE ROLE:
We are seeking applications from Environmental Engineers with previous Tailings experience to join our Perth-based team. The role would offer you the ability to grow your career with a strong technical team around you offering support and mentoring.

Reporting to Principal Engineers, the Environmental Engineer will assist in assessing the impact of engineering activities on water and soil, and support the planning and design of systems and processes for the treatment, control and safe disposal of waste materials. The role will also contribute to identifying and assessing environmental issues that may create long-term impacts, and to developing practical engineering solutions to address them.
This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer to further develop technical capability within a strong multidisciplinary team, with support and mentoring from experienced professionals.

RESPONSIBILITES:
The Environmental Engineer will assist with:

- Assessing the impact of engineering projects on water balance analysis, soil conditions and the wider environment.
- Supporting the planning and design of engineering systems and processes for waste treatment, pollution control and safe disposal of waste materials.
- Assisting with site inspections, monitoring programs and data analysis.
- Contributing to environmental impact assessments, technical studies and risk assessments.
- Preparing technical reports, calculations, specifications and engineering documentation.
- Supporting project teams to ensure compliance with relevant environmental legislation, standards and approval conditions.
- Liaising with internal teams, clients and stakeholders to support the delivery of environmental engineering outcomes within time and budget constraints.

To be successful in the role you will need:

- A Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent tertiary qualification in Environmental Engineering with minimum 1 to 2 years of experience in the related field.
- Exposure to environmental impact assessment, pollution control, waste treatment, water management, contaminated land, remediation, or environmental compliance
- An understanding of the assessment of environmental impacts on water and soil.
- Well-developed computer skills, particularly engineering-related and office automation package such as GIS, Civil 3D and Rift TD.
- Strong communication, technical writing and reporting skills.
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
- A willingness to travel interstate and internationally when required.

Knight Piésold offer excellent remuneration packages and a competitive range of benefits including:

- performance bonus incentive programs;
- subsidised gym memberships / fitness classes;
- training and development opportunities;
- referral bonuses;
- early access to long service leave and more.

Expected salary range: $80,000- $95,000 per annum.

For further information, please visit our website: www.knightpiesold.com .

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Job position 

Recruitment Consultant

Role Summary

This is a full 360 Recruitment Consultant role, offering the opportunity to develop and manage your own specialist technology recruitment desk within a high-growth sector.
You will be responsible for building long-term relationships with both clients and candidates, managing the full recruitment lifecycle, and developing your own market presence within a specialist technology niche.
Whether you are an experienced recruiter looking to advance your career or someone with an established background in technology recruitment, Pearson Carter offers comprehensive training, genuine career progression opportunities, and a high-performance culture that rewards success.

Responsibilities
Candidate Management & Delivery
•	Source and engage high-quality technology professionals through our CRM, ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and market mapping activities.
•	Build and maintain a strong network of candidates within your specialist technology market.
•	Conduct candidate qualification calls and interviews to assess technical skills, experience, motivations, and suitability.
•	Manage candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing guidance, preparation, and feedback.
•	Coordinate and secure interviews between candidates and clients.
•	Negotiate and manage offer processes through to successful placement.
Client Management & Business Development
•	Develop and manage relationships with new and existing clients across Australia and the wider APAC region.
•	Conduct business development activities to identify and secure new recruitment partnerships.
•	Generate new client opportunities through networking, referrals, market research, and proactive outreach.
•	Arrange and attend meetings with prospective and existing clients, both virtually and in person.
•	Negotiate terms of business and recruitment agreements.
•	Account manage key client relationships, ensuring a high level of service and delivery.
•	Develop a thorough understanding of client businesses, hiring requirements, and market challenges.
Market Development
•	Build a recognised market presence within your specialist technology niche.
•	Develop strong networks across both candidate and client communities.
•	Stay informed on industry trends, salary benchmarking, competitor activity, and market developments.
•	Create and publish professional recruitment content across LinkedIn and other relevant platforms to strengthen personal and company branding.
•	Contribute to the growth and expansion of Pearson Carter's technology recruitment offering across the APAC region.
Operational Excellence
•	Maintain accurate records within the CRM and Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
•	Manage recruitment processes efficiently, ensuring exceptional candidate and client experiences.
•	Achieve and exceed individual activity, billing, and revenue targets.
•	Collaborate with colleagues across our international offices to share market knowledge and opportunities.
 About you
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
•	Previous Recruitment experience within Technology, Software Development, IT, Digital, AI, ERP, Data, Cloud, Cyber Security, or related recruitment markets.
•	Previous Sales, Marketing or Account management experience.
•	Experience building and developing a successful recruitment desk.
•	A strong track record in sales, business development, or a target-driven environment.
•	Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
•	The ability to manage multiple recruitment processes simultaneously.
•	Strong networking, negotiation, and influencing abilities.
•	High levels of self-motivation, resilience, and professionalism.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills.
•	A collaborative approach and desire to contribute to a growing team environment.

For the candidate 
Full time contract
This is a permanent role so please only apply if you have full working rights in Australia. 
No recruitment agencies please

result.description: Mojo Dojo Corporation Pty Ltd  We are seeking an experienced Advertising Specialist to join our team at Mojo Dojo. In this role, you will devise, plan, and coordinate advertising campaigns with a strong focus on paid digital channels that encourage consumers to purchase client goods and services. This role is critical to delivering measurable growth for Mojo Dojo’s clients through strategic campaign planning, execution, and optimisation in a fast-paced digital agency environment.   Benefits   Competitive salary of $82,000 + superannuation  Work in a creative and collaborative digital agency environment  Opportunity to manage end-to-end campaigns across multiple clients and industries  Professional development and training opportunities  Modern office in South Melbourne with flexible working arrangements  Supportive team culture with regular social events    Task & responsibilities   Planning, developing and organising advertising policies and campaigns to support sales objectives and client ROI targets.  Advising executives and clients on advertising strategies and campaigns to reach target markets, creating consumer awareness, and effectively promoting the attributes of goods and services.  Coordinating production of advertising campaigns involving specialised activities such as artwork, copywriting, scripting, and social media and search engine placement within time and budget constraints.  Researching potential demand and market characteristics for new goods and services; collecting and analysing data and other statistical information.  Supporting business growth and development through the preparation and execution of marketing objectives, policies and programs.  Commissioning and undertaking market research to identify market opportunities for new and existing goods and services.  Advising on all elements of marketing such as product mix, pricing, advertising, sales promotion, selling, and distribution channels.  Creating, scheduling and publishing marketing content to social media platforms and websites.  Monitoring performance of initiatives, providing regular reporting and insights; analysing data from digital marketing campaigns and platforms; recommending updates to improve search engine and advertising metrics.    Qualification & experience   AQF Bachelor degree or higher (or assessed equivalent) in Advertising, Marketing, Communications, Business (with a major in marketing/advertising), or a highly relevant field  Minimum 2 years of post-qualification, full-time (or equivalent) experience in advertising campaign management  Experience working in a digital marketing agency environment, particularly with paid advertising, PPC, and social media campaigns, is highly regarded  Proven track record using digital advertising platforms, data analysis, client liaison, and delivering measurable campaign results  Strong written and verbal communication skills   About Company    Mojo Dojo is a dynamic digital marketing agency based in South Melbourne. We specialise in helping businesses grow through targeted advertising campaigns, data-driven strategies, and creative digital solutions. Our team works with a diverse range of clients across various industries, delivering measurable results through paid media, social media, and search marketing.  We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, focus on innovation, and commitment to achieving strong outcomes for our clients. At Mojo Dojo, you’ll have the opportunity to work on varied campaigns, develop your skills, and contribute directly to client success in a supportive and fast-paced environment.
